phase: validation-only feasibility pilot; no novelty or operational guarantee
split_revision: Original geometric test blocks and test sample files remain frozen. Non-test blocks are assigned with class-support constraints by a benchmark simulator using only non-test labels. Acquisition never sees unacquired labels.
features: five center bands plus 7x7 patch means and standard deviations; no spectral-index reflectance assumption
model: multinomial logistic regression, C=1, max_iter=2000; training class balance shared by all variants
adaptation: CORAL: source whitening and target recoloring; statistics use source training and unlabeled adaptation pool only
budgetmatched_baselines: 700 controller annotations are instead used as ordinary training labels by budgetmatched methods; no adaptive feedback. Equal total label budget, different allocation.
fixed_policy: coefficient r applies to water, tiles, asphalt and concrete; other training/query multipliers remain1; labels are shared, cost-dependent fitted models need not be identical
cost_interpretation: hypothetical water/artificial-surface emphasis; not measured ecological harm; symmetric cost also reported
adaptive_rule: per-class smoothed controller FNR: <=0.10:1; <=0.25:3; <=0.50:5; >0.50:7; fewer than10 controller examples:1
query: entropy or minimum expected fixed/scaled cost on adaptation pool; stable ranking; no hidden-label access
decision: all methods use the same fixed evaluation cost matrix for reported predictions; adaptive coefficients affect fitting and acquisition only
target_label_accounting: acquisition budget +700 controller labels; 2000 development labels separately counted as evaluation overhead
sample_universe: grid centers within released reference-label support; zero labels are unannotated, not background; oracle simulation
limitations: One acquisition/scene; within-scene regional transfer. Source and controller class-stratified sampling and class-support-aware block assignment assume benchmark annotation access; not a deployment policy. Development enrichment is corrected by inclusion-probability weights. Block/buffer sensitivity and a second scene are required before confirmatory claims.
